active.hypothesis: Replacing direct paid-product traffic with a tightly matched free Private AI readiness kit will convert qualified social attention into measurable downloads, while the existing checkout cross-sell creates a low-friction path to the €7 setup guide.
active.major_variable: Campaign destination and hook: aligned free readiness kit instead of direct paid-guide pitch.

manual_analytics.note: Optional on the evaluation date; the CLI does not expose page views.

guardrails: Keep the aligned lead product, €7 core price, LAUNCH30 offer, and campaign destinations stable until evaluation.
Publish at most one campaign post per owned social account in a rolling 24 hours.
Do not automate unsolicited likes, follows, boosts, reposts, replies, or direct messages.
Do not create another SKU or publish intentional duplicate drafts.
Do not invent scarcity or guarantee privacy, performance, compatibility, or income.
Repair delivery defects and false claims immediately.

history.hypothesis: Specific privacy, model-choice, and troubleshooting lessons will generate qualified traffic for a low-risk €7 local-AI guide, then the replacement upsell will lift order value with the complete toolkit.

decision.rationale: The campaign reached its posting sample but produced no measurable lead or sale.
